A small, black ceramic vessel with an enclosed top featuring several perforated holes. The vessel features a narrow handle, thin pouring spout and a flat base.  In places, the applied black colouring is chipped, revealing orange coloured fired clay underneath.

Object Information

Acq. No MU3368
Material Ceramic
Dimensions Lorem Ipsum
Details Athens, c.400-350 B.C.E. Purchased in 1997.
